case_name: Appellate jurisdiction of Supreme Court in appeals from High Courts in regard to civil matters
facts: The Supreme Court has jurisdiction to hear appeals from High Courts in civil matters.
A certificate is required from the High Court under Article 134A before an appeal can be filed with the Supreme Court.
court_reasoning: Notwithstanding anything in this Article, no appeal shall, unless Parliament by law otherwise provides, lie to the Supreme Court from the judgment, decree or final order of one Judge of a High Court.
holding: No appeal shall lie to the Supreme Court from the judgment, decree or final order of one Judge of a High Court, unless Parliament by law otherwise provides.
